scope: S3 minimal local parsing and source localization only

docling.type: local multi-format document pipeline; neural layout/table models plus text backend
docling.code_license: MIT; individual model licenses separately verified before enabling
docling.plan: Start with pinned docling-parse text backend; attempt CPU-only full Docling standard locally, OCR disabled. Every output identifies exact adapter/configuration; baseline never claims full pipeline capability.

docling_parse.type: Docling project native PDF text/geometry backend, not full Docling layout/table pipeline

mineru.type: local document parsing tiers / optional remote service; base ONNX+llama.cpp runtime
mineru.code_license: MinerU Open Source License (Apache-2.0 plus commercial-threshold and online-attribution terms), model licenses separate
mineru.iteration_policy: Verify install feasibility/dependencies; no false GPU-only claim. No remote parsing or default third-party PDF upload. If not executed, mark not_run and explain actual reason, never fabricate comparative quality.

implementation_steps: Versioned Python ParserAdapter and DocumentIR v2 with v1 fixture compatibility, SHA and immutable text/geometry/normalization mappings
Local adapters, JSON CLI, per-page coverage/error reporting and exact segment validation
Parse five exposed PDFs unchanged; actual timings and resources; localization evidence only, human fidelity pending
Constructed-PDF coordinate/Unicode/cross-block/error/version tests plus existing type/unit/integration/evaluation regressions; logs exclusively under s3
Append engineering delivery evidence to current plans without changing stage acceptance or thresholds

engineering_resource_budget.network: Official package/source/model downloads only; original PDFs stay local; zero paid LLM calls

quality_limits: Reading order / table/header/caption linkage not accepted until manual PDF comparison
Visible image text and mixed pages needing OCR never count as fully covered
Engineering coverage and quality fidelity reported separately
Five files are exposed development candidates, not independent acceptance
